S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S025.name: Loss_of_Interest
S025.description: A state where interest or pleasure in previously enjoyed activities is markedly diminished.

subtypes.Loss of Interest: Reduced interest in previously enjoyed hobbies or leisure activities.
subtypes.Social Withdrawal: Reduced interest or effort in social interactions and maintaining relationships.
subtypes.Loss of Motivation: Lack of motivation to initiate or complete work or tasks.
subtypes.Anhedonia: Inability to experience positive emotions such as happiness, satisfaction, love, or pleasure.
subtypes.Indifference to Achievement: Insensitivity or indifference to personal achievements or success.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.

subtypes.Significant Weight Loss: Weight loss of more than 5% in a month without dieting.
subtypes.Weight Gain: Weight gain of more than 5% in a month.
subtypes.Decrease in Appetite: Decrease in appetite occurring nearly every day.
subtypes.Increase in Appetite: Increase in appetite occurring nearly every day.

S028.name: Psychomotor_Changes
S028.description: Observable increase or decrease in psychomotor activity.

subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Purposeless repetitive behaviors such as inability to sit still, pacing, hand-wringing, or picking at skin.
subtypes.Psychomotor Retardation (Motor): Visible slowing of general body movements, such as walking speed or picking up objects.
subtypes.Psychomotor Retardation (Speech): Long response latency or slowed speech when asked a question.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.

subtypes.Reduced Concentration: Unable to pay attention or maintain focus on specific activities like conversation, reading, or watching TV.
subtypes.Indecisiveness: Extreme difficulty making even minor daily choices (e.g., menu, clothes) and hesitating to make decisions.
subtypes.Subjective Memory Complaints: Complaining of memory decline, such as forgetting where things were placed, due to reduced focus.
subtypes.Clouded Thinking: Thinking feels foggy, dazed, or not clear.

S032.name: Death_Suicide
S032.description: Recurrent thoughts of death, recurrent suicidal ideation, or a suicide attempt.

subtypes.Recurrent Thoughts of Death: Passive wish to die (e.g., 'I wish I wouldn't wake up') without active intent to kill oneself.
subtypes.Suicidal Ideation: Recurring thoughts of 'I want to die' or 'I want to kill myself' without a specific plan.
subtypes.Suicidal Impulse: Strong, sudden urges to jump from a height or run into traffic without a concrete plan.
subtypes.Specific Plan for Suicide: Conceiving specific scenarios or methods regarding when, where, and how to die.
subtypes.Suicide Attempt: Actual actions taken to end one's life or preparatory behaviors like hoarding pills or writing a will.

info.persona: Cyntrell Glin blends disciplined engineering precision with hands‑on creativity, turning every project—from woodworking to community mentorship—into a well‑organized, curiosity‑driven endeavor, all while balancing a love of tradition with a willingness to explore new horizons, and they rarely pass up a chance to tinker late into the night.
info.professional_persona: Cyntrell Glin, a retired mechanical and electrical engineer turned community mentor, applies a disciplined, data‑driven mindset honed in manufacturing to woodworking, maker‑space planning, and crafting clear technical guides for youth STEM programs, balancing a curiosity for new tools with proven techniques, and they readily share these insights with neighbors and students alike.
info.cultural_background: Cyntrell grew up as a Black Texan in the post‑civil‑rights era, shaped by a close‑knit family that emphasized church, community service, and resilience. His cultural heritage is reflected in the soulful gospel music he enjoys, the Southern‑style cuisine passed down through generations, and the strong emphasis on education and mentorship within his community. He values the legacy of African‑American engineers who paved the way in the South and honors those traditions through his volunteer work, storytelling, and dedication to preserving local history. Living in Maud, he blends the rural Texan way of life with the rich cultural tapestry of his Black heritage.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Cyntrell enjoys a variety of hands‑on and intellectually stimulating pursuits. He spends hours in his workshop crafting furniture and restoring classic cars, while maintaining a meticulously tended garden that provides fresh herbs and vegetables. He finds relaxation in fishing trips on nearby lakes, reading historical nonfiction and biographies of pioneering engineers, and playing chess with fellow retirees at the local community center. His church involvement includes volunteering for the choir and organizing youth outreach events. He also loves traveling to historic civil‑rights sites and participating in birdwatching excursions in the Texas countryside.
info.sports_persona: Cyntrell Glin, an avid early‑morning fisherman and devoted Dallas Cowboys fan, spends weekends on Lake Texoma casting for bass, joins the local senior walking club for low‑impact cardio, and enjoys watching the Texas Rangers on television while occasionally cheering at community high‑school football games, and they consider each activity a chance to blend leisurely pursuits with disciplined routine.
info.arts_persona: Cyntrell Glin, a choir volunteer who loves the harmonies of the Mormon Tabernacle Choir and the soulful slide of B.B. King, attends regional folk festivals featuring The Carter Family and enjoys reading biographies of pioneering engineers, using the stories as inspiration for their own woodworking art, and they often surprise friends with impromptu renditions of classic gospel hymns.
info.travel_persona: Cyntrell Glin, a methodical traveler with a penchant for heritage tours, has driven the historic Route 66 to the National Civil Rights Museum in Memphis, plans annual birdwatching excursions to the Texas Hill Country, and carefully maps each trip in a leather‑bound journal to maximize both learning and leisure, and they pride themselves on balancing meticulous preparation with spontaneous moments of discovery.
info.culinary_persona: Cyntrell Glin, a garden‑to‑table enthusiast, frequently cooks herb‑infused chicken piccata with fresh rosemary and thyme harvested from their backyard, perfects homemade coleslaw with crisp cabbage, and indulges in occasional smoked brisket seasoned with a secret rub that includes smoked paprika and brown sugar, and they never miss a chance to share a plate with neighbors, although they sometimes forget to turn off the stovetop in their excitement.

info.persona: Desserie Figueroa blends a nurse’s precision with an artist’s imagination, juggling community health workshops, vibrant canvases, a habit of buying too many brushes, and never missing an evening yoga session.
info.professional_persona: Desserie Figueroa, an LPN with a solid grounding in patient assessment, wound care, and health informatics, leverages their vivid imagination and collaborative spirit to weave abstract art into community health workshops while methodically preparing for RN‑to‑BSN certification within two years.
info.cultural_background: As a native of Río Grande and Canóvanas in Puerto Rico, Desserie grew up immersed in a bilingual, family‑oriented environment that values community solidarity and cultural celebration. Her upbringing blended traditional Puerto Rican customs—such as the annual fiestas patronales, bomba and plena rhythms, and the preparation of dishes like arroz con gandules—with the modern influences of a developing island. She is fluent in Spanish and English, and her identity is shaped by the island’s colonial history, its resilience in the face of natural disasters, and its vibrant artistic scene. These experiences foster a deep commitment to serving her fellow Puerto Ricans, preserving cultural heritage, and integrating cultural relevance into her nursing practice.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Desserie is an avid visual artist who spends her free time painting abstract landscapes and sketching botanical subjects inspired by the natural beauty of El Yunque. She enjoys reading speculative fiction and philosophy, which satisfy her curiosity for novel ideas. Outdoor activities such as hiking, salsa dancing, and practicing yoga help her maintain balance between social engagement and personal reflection. She volunteers at local community centers, leading health workshops and art‑based stress‑relief sessions. Cooking traditional Puerto Rican dishes and exploring the island’s music scene are also important parts of her cultural expression.
info.sports_persona: Desserie Figueroa embraces sunrise hikes through the rainforest trails of El Yunque, practices yoga three times weekly for flexibility, attends lively salsa dance sessions that double as cardio, supports the Cangrejeros de Santurce basketball team during the winter season, and joins a local running club for weekend 5K runs.
info.arts_persona: Desserie Figueroa spends evenings painting abstract landscapes inspired by misty canopies, sketching detailed botanical studies of native foliage, devouring speculative fiction by N.K. Jemisin and philosophical treatises by Simone de Beauvoir, and curating playlists that feature the vibrant sounds of Celia Cruz and the rhythmic percussion of traditional bomba music, allowing art and literature to fuel their creative therapies.
info.travel_persona: Desserie Figueroa prefers immersive, nature‑focused trips that blend active exploration with creative downtime, having trekked the rainforest trails of El Yunque, explored the colonial streets of Old San Juan, dreamed of hiking Iceland’s volcanic landscapes, and longs to attend a yoga retreat in Bali’s rice‑field terraces.
info.culinary_persona: Desserie Figueroa cooks with a confident hand, regularly preparing mofongo with chicharrón, arroz con gandules seasoned with sofrito, and alcapurrias, while experimenting by adding smoked paprika to plantain fritters, and they favor fresh cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of adobo spice in most dishes.

info.persona: Janio Delcanal is a methodical security professional who balances a love of solitary puzzle‑solving and mindfulness with a restless worry that fuels both disciplined fitness routines and meticulous workplace vigilance.
info.professional_persona: Janio Delcanal, a 39‑year‑old security operations veteran, excels at real‑time CCTV monitoring, threat detection, and incident reporting on bustling casino floors, where their meticulous, organized approach and practical curiosity drive strict protocol adherence, junior guard training, and a clear path toward a senior supervisory role.
info.cultural_background: Janio’s Nicaraguan heritage is a central part of his identity. Raised in a bilingual household, he grew up speaking Spanish at home while learning English in school, giving him a fluid cultural fluency that serves him well in Miami’s diverse environment. Family values rooted in respect for elders, strong community ties, and Catholic traditions shape his cooperative and considerate nature. He regularly participates in local Central‑American festivals, enjoys the rhythms of salsa and punta, and prepares family meals that honor his mother’s recipes. Living in Miami’s vibrant diaspora, Janio blends his Central American roots with the city’s multicultural influences, creating a hybrid identity that balances nostalgia for his homeland with adaptation to American life.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his spare time, Janio enjoys activities that combine solitary focus with personal growth. He maintains a disciplined fitness routine that includes weight training and early‑morning jogs, which help him manage stress. He has a keen interest in true‑crime literature and security‑technology documentaries, feeding his curiosity while staying practical. Janio also loves cooking traditional Nicaraguan dishes for his family, playing acoustic guitar at home, solving puzzles such as crosswords and Sudoku, and practicing mindfulness meditation to calm his nervous disposition. Occasionally, he volunteers at his local community center, assisting with youth mentorship programs.
info.sports_persona: Janio Delcanal pursues fitness through disciplined weight‑training sessions and sunrise jogs, competes weekly in a local 5K running club, follows the hometown baseball team, the Cubs, and occasionally joins pickup basketball games at the community center’s youth mentorship program.
info.arts_persona: Janio Delcanal unwinds by strumming an acoustic guitar, favoring fingerstyle pieces by Andrés Segovia and John Williams, while devouring true‑crime books by Ann Rule and listening to classic folk singer Bob Dylan, and they binge security‑technology documentaries featuring Edward Snowden.
info.travel_persona: Janio Delcanal prefers structured, short‑duration trips that blend relaxation with cultural immersion, often planning weekend getaways to historic colonial towns like Granada and saving for a longer dream voyage to the Pacific coast of Chile, balancing travel costs with family responsibilities.
info.culinary_persona: Janio Delcanal channels disciplined focus into the kitchen, perfecting family‑style dishes such as gallo pinto, nacatamales, and vigorón, savoring the aroma of plantains, beans, and recaito, while occasionally experimenting with a spicy salsa roja to impress guests.
